title: Circular Dependency Report (worked example)
summary: A worked example: a real four-unit uses cycle, and the report drag-lint produces for it
intro: Read this to see what a circular uses report looks like before you run one. It walks through a real four-unit uses cycle and the report drag-lint produces for it, every line taken from the index, and shows which cycles the playbook cuts and which it leaves to you.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Circular Uses Report (cycles + fix plan)...
steps: Read the worked example on the wiki page
To produce the real report for your project choose drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Circular Uses Report (cycles + fix plan)...

questions.ask: What does a circular uses report look like before I run one?
